query:
INSERT INTO
            project_screenshot (
                screenshot_id,
                project_id,
                media_type,
                image,
                width,
                height,
                alt_text,
                caption,
                sort_order
            )
        SELECT
            ?1,
            ?2,
            ?3,
            ?4,
            ?5,
            ?6,
            ?7,
            ?8,
            COALESCE(MAX(sort_order), 0) + 1
        FROM
            project_screenshot
        WHERE
            project_id = ?2
